method: Read-only SQLite backups of the registered stores and copies of disposable indexes; isolated engine ownership. Same fourteen private queries, three rounds, pinned CPU BGE-small, no model generation. Case identifiers replace query text.

before.privacy: Aggregate counts only; query text, findings, identifiers and source text excluded.
limitations: Not a source-backed relevance/recall quality evaluation.
Cold deep queries use lexical retrieval when a query embedding is uncached.
Foreground contention uses conservative deferral; this does not certify concurrent deep semantic execution.
No Qwen, speech, refresh, RSS or multi-character measurements.

interpretation: Thirty-nine topic investigations now return accepted memories. Three strict event-date queries correctly exclude undated records. All retained results pass current dependency inspection. Contending deep attempts are deferred; this is not evidence of completed concurrent deep semantic recall.

authenticated_control_api.method: LocalRuntime uses deployment settings and existing character binding copied into the isolated snapshot. BrowserControl bootstrap, investigation and inspection routes use ASGI transport. No room connection or model generation.
